sourceHierarchy.permittedRole: daylight column-AOD/aerosol retrieval constraint near the observing date when valid retrieval pixels exist
requiredEvidenceBeforeUse: time separation from the X-Shooter sequence
sourceHierarchy.selectionRule: search all geometrically covering Collection-6.1 granules on the observation date and adjacent UTC dates; retain every valid QA-qualified retrieval in a frozen ledger before any MYSTIC residual is opened
sourceHierarchy.absenceRule: no valid retrieval remains MISSING; do not substitute a lower-QA pixel because it agrees with MYSTIC

collections.role: column/surface aerosol diagnostics including AOD constraints

sourceHierarchy.permittedRole: externally specified reanalysis aerosol state/envelope independent of the X-Shooter sky residuals
requiredEvidenceBeforeUse: exact granule identifiers and downloaded-byte SHA-256
nearest grid-cell identity plus a fixed 3x3 spatial context stencil
all temporal samples bracketing the confirmed X-Shooter sequence time
explicit REANALYSIS provenance on every derived input

requestedAerosolFields: total aerosol optical depth at 550 nm
dust aerosol optical depth at 550 nm
sea salt aerosol optical depth at 550 nm
sulphate aerosol optical depth at 550 nm
organic matter aerosol optical depth at 550 nm
black carbon aerosol optical depth at 550 nm
available aerosol mixing-ratio fields on model levels
sourceHierarchy.permittedRole: independent-of-X-Shooter-residual reanalysis cross-envelope for column loading and modeled composition/profile
requiredEvidenceBeforeUse: exact request payload and downloaded-byte SHA-256
nearest grid-cell identity plus a fixed 3x3 spatial context stencil
all 3-hour samples bracketing the confirmed sequence time
model-level/pressure-level semantics for any vertical field
explicit REANALYSIS provenance on every derived input

fixedSpatialTemporalRules.reanalysisSpatialRule: use the geometrically nearest grid cell as primary and a fixed 3x3 stencil only to quantify spatial representativeness; never choose a cell from radiance agreement
fixedSpatialTemporalRules.reanalysisTemporalRule: after archive timestamp semantics are confirmed, use the immediately bracketing native output times; any interpolation method and uncertainty must be frozen before MYSTIC residual opening
fixedSpatialTemporalRules.satelliteRule: record actual overpass time and distance for every QA-qualified retrieval; daylight retrievals constrain aerosol state but are not contemporaneous night measurements
